name: racelab-storage
description: RaceLab B2 storage core (D11: local store is the only source of truth; append-only outbox; cloud backup is NOT sync). Injected drivers (KeyValueDriver/SqlExecutor), DocStore+AppendLog adapters (memory/sqlite/kv/expo-sqlite glue), typed repos with parse-on-read + quarantine, legacy-blob migration. Zero runtime deps, zero node built-ins in src/ — bundles into the app unchanged (D18 culture: all I/O injected).
